5) the a-c-t-o-r p-r-e-s-e-n-t-e-d the p-r-o-c-e-s-s as c-o-m-p-e-t-i-t-i-v-e to the p-r-o-c-u-r-e-m-e-n-t, l-e-f-t the s-e-a-l-e-d a-r-c-h-i-v-e m-a-r-k-e-d closed, and s-k-i-p-p-e-d the f-i-n-a-l a-u-d-i-t r-e-c-o-n-c-i-l-i-a-t-i-o-n
